text: Prindle, Suel, and colleagues (2015) showed that Bacillus subtilis biofilms coordinate the metabolism of interior and peripheral cells using long-range traveling waves of membrane depolarization. These waves are propagated by the release and uptake of which ion?
explanation: The landmark 2015 discovery was a potassium wave: metabolically stressed interior cells open potassium channels, releasing K+ that depolarizes neighbors, which in turn open their channels, propagating the signal and redistributing metabolic resources. It is the clearest evidence of long-range electrical communication in bacterial communities. Calcium waves (option 0) were later characterized by the same lab but were not the 2015 finding; sodium and chloride are not the propagating ion here.
